summary: Reproduced the GPTQ Marlin MoE BF16 scale dtype mismatch, reversed TP act-order w2 scale allocation, and missing full-table loader behavior in the checked-out implementation. Scale parameters now follow params_dtype; desc_act=True allocates and loads the full w2 scale table while desc_act=False retains per-rank sharding.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: BF16 scales were FP16, both TP=2 act-order shape cases were reversed, and the w2 loader rejected full-table loading (4 failed, 1 passed). Raw output: reports/j-f3393975e585/regression-before.txt

Passing-after regression and boundary cases for FP16/BF16 allocation, TP=2 desc_act false/true shapes, and sharded/full w2 table loading (5 passed). Raw output: reports/j-f3393975e585/regression-after.txt
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, and registered-test CI metadata checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-f3393975e585/pre-commit.txt
Confirmed one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950-class ROCm device is visible; raw output: reports/j-f3393975e585/hardware.txt

remaining_limitations: The reported two-rank CUDA Marlin serving workload and NaN logits were not executed because only one AMD ROCm GPU is assigned and the model weights are unavailable.
The regression validates the precise dtype, tensor-shape, metadata, and loader-sharding defects in the actual implementation, but does not establish end-to-end model semantic accuracy.
